parcels_absent_reason: NOT YET SEARCHED. Altadena is unincorporated Los Angeles County, CA, and LA County Assessor parcel data is published (Open Data / ArcGIS) — so a well is expected to exist and this DECLARED-NONE is a placeholder that should not survive the next pass on this town. ⛔ Recorded as a finding rather than left undeclared, because undeclared and none print differently and only one of them is honest here. Whoever adopts the LA County well replaces this whole block.
